name: f07-fragment-with-personal-context
description: SYNTHETIC. A fragment that only resolves if the system knows where this person actually goes. Tests condition C2 against C0/C1 — without personal context there is nothing to attach 「さくら」 to.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: 今日はどこか行かれますか？

personalContext._note: SYNTHETIC. Invented. Not a real person.

expect.notes: Under ctx=none or ctx=session the correct outcome is closer to zero hypotheses — 「さくら」 attaches to nothing. Under ctx=personal a reading around さくら台病院 should appear, citing the personalContext path it came from. The comparison between conditions is the measurement; a model that produces the same answer in all three is not using the context it was given.
